description: Choose a local fallback when your AI client cannot interpret an attachment. Starts an asynchronous job: auto selects transcription for audio, visual analysis plus transcript for video, description for images, or document text extraction. Choose cache to download a large attachment in the background without running a model, then transfer its fileId using read_media_chunk. Choose summarize to transcribe a voice note (or extract the text of a document or video) and get a short local summary plus the full text. Other modes: transcribe, frames, analyze, ocr, extract. Poll get_media_analysis. Sources up to 500 MB; no paid APIs.

chat.description: Exact WhatsApp chat JID from list_chats, or a phone number with country code

profile.description: Which linked WhatsApp to use: a profile id or name from list_profiles. Leave out for the main profile.
